# fco_managed_vm_locations (Data Source)

Lists all available datacenter locations.

Access the results via `fco_managed_vm_locations.<name>.locations`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all available datacenter locations.
data "fco_managed_vm_locations" "all" {
}

# Access with `fco_managed_vm_locations.all.locations`.
# e.g. fco_managed_vm_locations.all.locations[0].uuid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed locations.
- `locations` (Attributes List) The list of all available datacenter locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `title` (String) The title of the datacenter location, e.g. `Nürnberg (RZ1)`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the datacenter location.
